items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains only a bibliographic note referencing 'Rose & Souchon' in a book title. The interviewee's spoken text discusses 'Jordan's band' and 'Lovie Taylor', with no mention of Rose & Souchon or any personal interaction.

ctx.x: (REMAINDER OF FIRST TAPE ALMOST COMPLETELY INAUDIBLE. TYPIST DID NOT THINK WORTHWHILE TO TRY TO TRANSCRIBE).
* Lyric Theater- 201 Burgundy Street. viz- Rose & Souchon, New Orleans Jazz; A Family Album, p. 212 1967 ed.

Jordan's band. And they played 'Sweet Georgia Brown' for a cat to dance by the name of Lovie Taylor. Boy and did that cat dance. And that music was so precious perfect behind this cat's taps. He was a tap dancer but it was soft shoe. He didn't have no taps on his shoes.
